text: On January 26, 2026, the Board of Directors, CreateTO re-established the CreateTO Human Resources Committee and amended the Terms of Reference. The Board made two appointments to the committee, leaving one vacancy on the committee. This letter recommends the appointment of Marcie Zajdeman to the CreateTO Human Resources Committee.

The Board of Directors, CreateTO: 1. Re-opened item RA23.9, headed “Re-establishing the CreateTO - Human Resources Committee”. 2. Appointed Marcie Zajdeman to the CreateTO - Human Resources Committee.
